entities.summary: Konstantinos "Kostas" Petropoulos is a Greek former professional basketball coach, and a retired professional basketball player. During his playing career, he was nicknamed "Nureyev". His number 7 jersey was retired by Apollon Patras, in 2016. On 1 February 2020, the Kostas Petropoulos Indoor Hall basketball arena, was named after him, in his honor.
